methods.finiteWindow: FiniteCorrelationWindow: ordered [-ceil(2.5 alpha/pitch),ceil(2.5 alpha/pitch)); magnitude of complex sum, explicitly labeled compatibility quadrature
methods.fractionScope: CoherenceFraction controls the Gamma spectrum, not automatic native PSF cropping
methods.fourier: FourierModes: smallest square enclosing Fraction of full spectral magnitude; nonnegative real weights >=0.001 of full real spectral peak; normalize Gamma(0)=1
methods.kernelScope: PsfSize explicitly controls finite complex impulse support

boundaries: Native zero-padding-off coordinate header is inconsistent with the source-derived pitch; four rasters do not certify axes
Other native Fraction settings and larger output domains can require additional native PSF auto-cropping parity; diagnostic wide/F90 failures preserved
No absolute watts, arbitrary mutual coherence matrices, field-varying coherence, reflective/vector/coating-phase certification
Dense source-pair work remains bounded; no silent incoherent fallback
